items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the dean of the conservatory, Dean Carl Nosse, came on stage and said, “We have a little surprise for Dave,”

ctx.x: One of the highlights of your college time was meeting your future wife. Can you tell me how that happened?

Oh yeah, because I’ll never forget it. The first time I met her, she was coming through a double door into the conservatory auditorium. She was going out. I was going in, so I held the door for her. We didn’t speak. Just nodded. Years later, I was giving a lecture before the concert in that same auditorium to students, asking me questions mostly. One question was the one you just asked me: how did you meet your wife? I was on stage, the very stage that we use today. I pointed from the stage to that door. I said,…
